_provenance: Provenance is set via NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE=true on the release workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml). Changesets honors that env var when running npm publish.
_ignore: Every workspace that is NOT part of a release must be listed, or changeset status surfaces it as a spurious patch bump. al-app-astro, al-app-home and al-app-southleft were missing — three fixture/marketing apps added after this list was last touched. @southleft/sl-web-components is deliberately listed too, but for a different reason: it is a LIBRARY, not a fixture, and whether it ships is an open decision in the publish-altitude-v2 spec. Listing it keeps the release surface honest until that decision is made; remove it here the moment it is meant to publish.
